In this video, Firstpost explains the white powder scare gripping the US ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. Suspicious letters targeting Congress and election offices have revived anthrax fears and raised questions about political intimidation and election security. The FBI is investigating. Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
